title: Wren and the Deadline
author: Xanthe Almeida
blurb: August Crane, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
